The company's commitment extends to broader diversity considerations including age diversity, people with disabilities, and various forms of individual diversity [Enel's 2022 Sustainability Report, p. 62]. Enel has adopted a Diversity and Inclusion Policy and aligns with the UN Global Compact's Women Empowerment Principles [Enel's 2022 Sustainability Report, p. 62]. The company's corporate governance model also incorporates diversity criteria in Board composition [Enel's 2023 Sustainability Report, p. 262].

Block 2 (detailed answer): 
Enel's 2022 Sustainability Report outlines its commitment to gender equality and diversity inclusion, demonstrating these efforts through policy frameworks and specific initiatives [Enel's 2022 Sustainability Report, p. 62]. The company adopted a Diversity and Inclusion Policy and aligned with the seven Women Empowerment Principles (WEP) promoted by the UN Global Compact and UN Women, in compliance with the UN Sustainable Development Goals [Enel's 2022 Sustainability Report, p. 62]. Key initiatives included actions addressing the gender gap and inclusion, listening and support services during the pandemic, projects for people with vulnerabilities, and awareness initiatives on LGBTQ+ topics and cultural diversity [Enel's 2022 Sustainability Report, p. 62]. The company also participated in the "Equal by 30" international campaign promoted by Clean Energy Ministerial, committing to gender equality in clean energy sector pay, leadership, and opportunities by 2030 [Enel's 2023 Sustainability Report, p. 199]. Enel's approach encompasses work-life integration, promoting personal and organizational well-being as enabling factors for engagement and innovation [Enel's 2022 Sustainability Report, p. 63].
